title: crataegus tanacetifolia var. glabra
intro: Crataegus tanacetifolia var. glabra, commonly known as the Russian hawthorn or glabrous maybush, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the family Rosaceae. It is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health, lower blood pressure, and act as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus tanacetifolia var. glabra include its cardiotonic, vasorelaxant, and antioxidant properties, which help to improve heart function and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being.
